name: Petunia's Cup
summary: A pale woman in black sits in the conservatory with a cup of tea she will not set down.

stages.journal: A lady in a mourning gown sits in the glass conservatory, facing a bergamot tree that is somehow alive. She holds a porcelain cup of dark tea, and she is in no hurry to give it up.
objectives: Win the porcelain cup from Petunia
stages.hint: Talk to the woman in the conservatory about what she holds dear.

stages.journal: She would not part with the cup, and she remembers who asked. We will have to come back with something she cares about more than her tea.
objectives: Win the porcelain cup from Petunia
stages.hint: Return to the conservatory when you have something of her children's to show her.

stages.journal: Petunia set down her cup, spoke a while of the life she had hoped for, and faded with her mind at rest. A green ribbon was left lying where she sat.
It came to blows. Petunia is gone, the cup lies among the dead vines, and the green ribbon at her throat is all that is left of her.
